name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Run the kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool on the first pending pen now. This cuts the bottleneck between content capture and transcript generation, freeing the creative team to work on edits instead of waiting for manual steps. The trade-off is accepting a temporary dependency on an external tool’s reliability, but the alternative—manual transcription—is slower and scales poorly.

name: Scriv
text: The risk isn’t the tool—it’s the single point of failure. If kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript breaks or gets rate-limited, the creative team stalls. A better fix: split transcript capture across two independent sources (e.g., YouTube API + a secondary scraper) and let the creative team pick the first valid output. Settle it by running a 48-hour stress test with both sources active.
